title: A client agent, with the approval gate
starter: Show me a client agent with the approval gate
intro: This is how an agent works for a client. An email arrives, the agent pulls out the details, records them with the client's own tool and drafts a reply. Then it stops, and only a person's approval sends anything.
disclaimer: A working re-creation. Oficina Norte (made up), the senders and the emails are all made up, and nothing is sent.
role: Reads an incoming email, records the job with the client's own tool, drafts a reply and waits for a person to approve it.

tool.name: jobs register
tool.workspace: The workspace of Oficina Norte (made up)

email.subject: Quote for 40 oak bedside tables
email.body:
Good morning,

We are refurbishing the rooms at Hotel Miradouro (made up) in Braga and need 40 oak bedside tables, 45 cm wide, with one drawer. We would need them delivered by 15 March.

Can you send us a quote?

Thank you,
Purchasing

fields.request: Oak bedside tables, 45 cm wide, one drawer

reply.subject: Your request for 40 oak bedside tables
reply.body:
Good morning,

We have your request for 40 oak bedside tables, 45 cm wide with one drawer, to be delivered in Braga by 15 March. It is with our team now, and one of them will come back to you with the quote.

email.subject: We need doors
email.body:
Hi,

Construtora Vale (made up) here. We need interior doors for a block of flats we are finishing in Guimarães. Pine, painted white.

What would that cost?

reply.subject: Your request for interior doors
reply.body:
Hi,

We have your request for pine interior doors, painted white, for the flats in Guimarães. To prepare it we need two things: how many doors, and when you need them. Once we have those, one of our team will come back to you.
